narrative.intro: Csi Aviation shows $1.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 9 awards with an average award size of $128M. Csi Aviation obligations are up 73.7% year over year for the fiscal-year-to-date period. The company’s obligation history shows a steady increase from FY21 through FY26: FY21 $2.4M, FY22 $4.8M, FY23 $162M, FY24 $350M, FY25 $661M, FY26 $1.1B. The Department of Homeland Security is the dominant buyer so far in FY2026 to date, accounting for $1.1B in obligations. The Department of Defense and the Department of Energy are much smaller buyers, with obligations of $1.7M and $721K respectively. The primary government market for Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.1B, followed by Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M. These figures are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date totals rather than full-year results.

sections.heading: Who are the biggest federal customers of Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $1.1B to Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K in the same period. These three agencies are the top buyers listed for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What products or services is Csi Aviation selling to the federal government?
sections.body: All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services is the largest market for Csi Aviation at $1.1B in FY2026 to date. Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation is a secondary market at $2.3M for the same period.

faq.q: How much does Csi Aviation make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Csi Aviation made $1.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company received 9 awards in the period with an average award size of $128M, and obligations are up 73.7% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Csi Aviation?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security is the largest federal customer of Csi Aviation at $1.1B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K in the same period.

faq.q: What does Csi Aviation sell to the government?
faq.a: Csi Aviation sells travel and air-transport services to the government, led by All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.1B in FY2026 to date. Csi Aviation also sells Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M in the same period.
